result.question: What was Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024?
result.answer: Apple's total net sales for fiscal year 2024 (the 52-week period ended September 28, 2024) were $391,035 million, or approximately $391.0 billion [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2024-09-28]. This figure is confirmed in Apple's 2024 Form 10-K Consolidated Statements of Operations, which report total net sales of $391,035 million for the year ended September 28, 2024 [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. The same total is reflected in the segment information disclosure, which also reports total net sales of $391,035 million for 2024 [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p020]. Of this total, Products net sales were $294,866 million and Services net sales were $96,169 million [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. The breakdown is also corroborated by the press release accompanying the 8-K filing, which reports the same Products and Services figures for the twelve months ended September 28, 2024 [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002].
